note: Seneca County NY publishes no queryable zoning district service. The Town and Village of Seneca Falls publish zoning only as static PDF maps (Town Zoning Map 11x17, Village Zoning Map 11x17); the county's GIS offering is a property search viewer (imo.co.seneca.ny.us) with parcels only. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches for Seneca County NY returned only flood zones, recycling routes and parcels, no zoning layer. Waterloo, Romulus, Tyre and Varick publish no zoning GIS found in search.
